_note: Class balance (tests/unit/balance.test.mjs, npm run balance-report): every car is its own class (car.json class) stock, and the most powerful build there is for it (tools/content/maxbuild.mjs: every part for sale, every setting) is at most maxClassJump classes higher — except the cars in exempt (the supercar, already at the top).

crashEconomy._note: What crashes cost against what races pay (npm run balance-report; the crash test suite's crashes, garage/crashSuite.js): the average full repair of a crash at each speed (into a wall, and into another car) at most that share of a win (data/economy.json raceRewards) — a scrape stays cheap, a big one costs about a race's winnings — and a quick repair at most quickShare of the full one.
